Accept paragraphs, composed emphasis/strong, code, safe links, nested sections and document-note asides, with the five XML entities and decimal/hex scalar references decoded once. Preserve text whitespace and explicit empty elements; CR and attribute TAB/LF/CR require numeric references to avoid XML normalization. Merge adjacent text nodes and remove empty text nodes. Unknown syntax, attributes, unsafe links, invalid characters, multiline headings, source over 8192 code points or traversal over 64 steps returns Err with a code-point location. This is not a general HTML/XML parser or a Markdown round-trip claim.

std:documentFromMarkdown.label: Document from Markdown
std:documentFromMarkdown.description: Import a bounded Markdown/XHTML fragment into the same typed Document: blank-line-separated single-line paragraphs, consecutive-level ATX headings, backtick code spans/fences, composed XHTML emphasis/strong and safe links, empty inline-code fallbacks, and exact XHTML paragraph/code/note blocks terminated by a blank line or EOF. Standard outlines attach following blocks to the latest heading; explicit section ends are not recoverable. Merge adjacent text, remove empty text, decode bounded XML entities once outside literal code, and ignore exact backtick-separator comments. Delimiter emphasis, bracket links/images, lists, quotes, soft wraps, paragraph/opening indentation, general HTML, unsafe links, malformed syntax, literal CR, source over 8192 code points and normalized export-depth failures return Err with a code-point location. Round trips apply to outline-shaped representable Documents within both bounds, not arbitrary original trees or all CommonMark.

std:rationalMembership.description: Membership for native exact integer-string ratios and their pure Int/PositiveNat form. Native parts beyond 4096 characters or pure spines beyond 128 inspected constructors abstain; a workload limit is not mathematical nonmembership. Unreduced valid ratios are admitted; checked construction normalizes them. Scalar Number is not an exact Rational representation.

std:rationalFromParts.label: Make exact Rational
std:rationalFromParts.description: Construct an exact Rational from two signed decimal integer strings, reduce to lowest terms and put the sign in the numerator. Invalid syntax, zero denominator and parts longer than 4096 characters refuse before the representation crossing. This is a workload bound, not a precision limit.

std:rationalToExactText.label: Exact Rational text
std:rationalToExactText.description: Write the normalized exact integer or numerator/denominator spelling. No value passes through floating arithmetic.

std:powerRational.label: Power of an exact Rational
std:powerRational.description: A whole Number exponent is a bounded iteration-count convenience for powerExactRational. Exact Rational exponents also admit perfect roots through that same operation.

std:approximateRational.label: Approximate Rational as Number
std:approximateRational.description: Explicit floating projection. Overflow or an unavailable finite projection refuses; exact arithmetic and text do not use this operation.

std:parseRational.label: Parse exact Rational
std:parseRational.description: Read a signed whole number, exact decimal, or signed integer fraction as a Rational. Decimals may use e/E with a signed integer exponent; .5 and 5. are accepted. Surrounding whitespace and whitespace beside a fraction slash are ignored. ASCII digits only: grouping separators, locale commas, hexadecimal, non-finite values and internal decimal whitespace refuse. Source text is limited to 4096 characters, exponent magnitude to 4096, and expanded numerator/denominator strings to 4096 characters each. The checked Rational constructor reduces the fraction and rejects zero denominators; no digits pass through a floating Number.

std:rootRationalExact.description: Exact root reference over the existing pure Rational, Int and Nat definitions. A valid degree is a whole iteration count from 1 through 64. The native ratio performance branch preserves this result; nonperfect roots and negative even roots return Nothing.

std:powerExactRational.label: Exact Rational power
std:powerExactRational.description: Raise a Rational to an exact Rational exponent p/q. Reduce the exponent before deciding the root, then return a Rational only when its qth root is exact. Negative bases allow odd roots; negative exponents require a nonzero base. Nonperfect roots require an explicit Real approximation. The existing 0^0 convention returns 1. The normalized numerator magnitude is at most 4096, root degree at most 64, and projected expansion at most 16384 characters; these workload bounds refuse without rounding.

std:taggedSingletonType.label: Tagged singleton type
std:taggedSingletonType.description: Build a tagged type whose phantom is the intersection of its declared domain and one typed value's singleton set.

std:boolToNative.description: Read a Bool's mathematical flag through its constructors. Pure False is a record at the host boundary and must never be tested by record truthiness.

std:natExactMembership.description: Admit a nonnegative safe whole Number, an exact Nat digit carrier beyond the safe Number capacity, or the existing pure Zero/Succ form. A small digit box is not the canonical representation; use the checked text parser to normalize it. More than 4096 carrier characters, unsafe whole Numbers, unreadable snapshots and more than 128 inspected pure constructors abstain instead of claiming mathematical nonmembership.

std:intExactMembership.description: Admit a safe whole Number, an exact Int digit carrier beyond the safe Number capacity, or the existing sign-magnitude Int with a Bool sign and an admitted Nat magnitude. The same canonical carrier, lexical and pure-inspection workload bounds as Nat apply.

std:integerCompareNumber.description: Compare an admitted exact Nat/Int with a finite Number endpoint, returning Just -1, Just 0 or Just 1. Fractional endpoints are compared through their floor. Endpoints beyond the safe whole-Number domain abstain because the current pure Number-to-Int bridge cannot advance there; this is an endpoint fragment fence, not an exact-integer precision limit. Exact integer values retain their full admitted digits.

std:parseNatExact.label: Parse exact Nat
std:parseNatExact.description: Read ASCII integer text as the existing Nat. Optional plus signs, leading zeroes and surrounding whitespace normalize; negative nonzero values and non-integer syntax refuse. Input is limited to 4096 characters. Every digit is preserved: safe whole values retain the existing Number representation, while larger values keep exact digit data.

std:parseIntExact.label: Parse exact Int
std:parseIntExact.description: Read signed ASCII integer text as the existing Int, preserving every digit. Optional signs, leading zeroes, negative zero and surrounding whitespace normalize. Decimal, fraction, exponent and non-finite syntax refuse. Input is limited to 4096 characters.

std:approximateNat.label: Approximate Nat as Number
std:approximateNat.description: Explicit floating projection of an admitted Nat. Large finite magnitudes may lose integer digits in the Number sample; non-finite samples and unsupported admission refuse. Exact integer arithmetic and text do not use this operation.

std:approximateInt.label: Approximate Int as Number
std:approximateInt.description: Explicit floating projection of an admitted Int. Large finite magnitudes may lose integer digits in the Number sample; non-finite samples and unsupported admission refuse. Exact integer arithmetic and text do not use this operation.

std:groupFoldStep.label: Group fold (step)
std:groupFoldStep.description: One step of groupFold: compute the element's key and ask the insert step to place it; once a step could not decide, keep Nothing without computing the key. Internal helper.

std:groupByKeyScanStep.label: Group by key (scan step)
std:groupByKeyScanStep.description: One step of groupByKeyInsert's scan of the groups, in order: the first group whose key is exactly equal to the candidate is found at the current index; an undecided comparison stops the scan; any later group is not compared. Internal helper.

std:countPerKey.label: Count per key
std:countPerKey.description: Count the members of each group of a grouping (the result of Group by): one entry per key, in the grouping's order, with its number of members. An undecided grouping (Nothing) stays Nothing. ∀k a. Maybe (Map k (List a)) → Maybe (Map k Number)

std:sumPerKey.label: Sum per key
std:sumPerKey.description: Sum a number of each member, per group of a grouping (the result of Group by): one entry per key, in the grouping's order, with the sum of its members' amounts. An undecided grouping (Nothing) stays Nothing. ∀k a. (a → Number) → Maybe (Map k (List a)) → Maybe (Map k Number)
